resource.title: RCKMS Content Codes
resource.description: The Reportable Condition Knowledge Management System (RCKMS) associates a standardized code with each condition available for authoring. This ValueSet contains condition codes included in the June 2021 content release. Please note that while there may be overlap with concepts referenced in RCKMS reporting logic, this value set is not intended to serve as a 'trigger' for case reporting.  When implementing trigger codes for electronic case reporting, use the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) file.
